agent_reasoning.reasoning: In code ENTER 00 is a navigation to a distinct route (/enter) with its own locked environment plate (ENTER_00_WAITING_ROOM), its own location label, and a reciprocal EXIT 00 that returns to ORIGIN. It is not an overlay (no modal/dialog, has a URL, has a status strip) and not global navigation (it does not persist across pages — it is one hop from Origin and offers destinations). It is the threshold between ORIGIN (outside) and the interior. Treat the trigger (header toggle, ENTER SITE 00 link, and ideally swipe-up) as a SHELL_INTERACTION whose single target is this portal; the directory content inside it is the WAITING ROOM. FAST TRAVEL is the actual GLOBAL_OVERLAY. Recommendation is contingent on founder decision U2 (merge LOCATIONS into WAITING ROOM).
